metadata.title: Sleep Profile Quiz — Discover Your Sleep Type
metadata.description: Take our free comprehensive sleep assessment. Discover your chronotype, sleep quality score, and personalized improvement plan in 3 minutes.

landing.heroSubtitle: A free 3-minute assessment to understand your chronotype, sleep quality, and habits. Science-backed, actionable results.
landing.feature1Desc: Are you a Bear, Wolf, Lion, or Dolphin? Learn your natural sleep-wake rhythm and peak performance hours.
landing.feature2Desc: Get a 0-100 score based on sleep latency, night waking, daytime alertness, and schedule consistency.
landing.feature3Desc: Identify hidden habits sabotaging your sleep — screen time, caffeine, exercise timing, and more.
landing.socialProof: Join thousands who discovered their sleep profile
landing.step1: Answer 26 questions about your sleep patterns
landing.step2: Get your personalized sleep profile instantly
landing.step3: Unlock your full report with actionable tips
landing.faq1Q: How long does the test take?
landing.faq1A: About 3 minutes. 26 questions across 3 dimensions: chronotype, sleep quality, and daily habits.
landing.faq2A: Our chronotype assessment is inspired by the Morningness-Eveningness Questionnaire (MEQ), and quality scoring follows PSQI methodology.
landing.faq3A: The basic sleep profile is completely free. A detailed report with personalized recommendations is available for a one-time fee.

result.upgradeDesc: Get your personalized improvement plan, detailed breakdown, and sleep optimization guide.

bear.name: Bear
bear.tagline: Follows the sun. The most common chronotype.
bear.description: Bears make up about 55% of the population. You follow a solar-based sleep-wake cycle, with peak energy in the late morning. You're most productive between 10 AM and 2 PM, and naturally wind down as the sun sets.
bear.sleepTip: Maintain a consistent 11 PM – 7 AM sleep schedule. Avoid caffeine after 2 PM.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.tagline: The night owl. Creative and unconventional.
wolf.description: Wolves comprise about 15% of the population. Your brain truly comes alive after sunset. Peak creativity and focus hit between 5-9 PM. Mornings are your kryptonite.
wolf.sleepTip: If your schedule allows, sleep from 12:30 AM – 8:30 AM. Use bright light therapy in the morning.

lion.name: Lion
lion.tagline: The early riser. Natural morning leader.
lion.description: Lions are about 15% of the population. You wake up before dawn with immediate energy. Your best thinking happens between 8 AM – noon. By evening, your battery is drained.
lion.sleepTip: Honor your early rhythm: sleep 9:30 PM – 5:30 AM. Schedule important tasks before noon.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.tagline: The light sleeper. Irregular and alert.
dolphin.description: Dolphins represent about 15% of the population. Named after the sleep pattern of real dolphins (half-brain sleep), you're a light, irregular sleeper with a racing mind at night.
dolphin.sleepTip: Build a rock-solid wind-down routine. Sleep 11:30 PM – 6:30 AM. White noise and meditation help.
